_comment: The film's factual and lexical ground truth. tools/review_plan.py checks every plan against this file BEFORE an executor is allowed to run. `terms` fixes the one correct spelling of every non-Indonesian word the film prints; `claims` are the statements the film makes, each with the words that must never appear on screen. Add a term or a claim the first time the film needs it — a plan may not invent a spelling or assert an undeclared fact.

terms.note: m20 printed CAHI in two cards and two shot briefs, and m04/m16 printed CHAI. The 'h' came from the ASR transcript and was copied into on-screen text.

terms.meaning: bukan 'cahaya' — film ini membantah pembacaan itu

claims.claim: Kata Sunda untuk air adalah 'cai', bukan 'cahi'; 'banyu' adalah kata Jawa dan 'tirta' kata Sanskerta/Jawa.
Dalam Sanskerta, kata untuk cahaya bukan 'ci'.
Gunung Sunda Purwa disebut lebih dari 17.000 meter; Everest 8.848 m; Gunung Sunda yang asli sekitar 4.000 m.
claims.source: angka yang diucapkan narasi m20 s06-s07
